title: Gameplay HUD gains crisp standalone controls
summary: The gameplay HUD now draws a sharp speed display and standalone minimap without boxed toolbar controls, while retaining the original game's restrained visual character.
details: The host settings gate confirmed the transparent pause/camera toolbar and standalone HUD during real driving across four viewport sizes and at 2× device scale.
The UI lifecycle regression also passed boot/course/model/context restoration, reduced motion, failed-content handling, touch targets, and portrait/landscape rotation.
limitation: Host-only verification; public deployment and verification are pending. This checkpoint does not establish original HUD pixel parity or physical-device rendering.
